paragraphs.text: The Northern Wilds is an inhospitable region with pine forests and rocky outcrops in northern Golthonor on Dominaria .
The Wilds are situated north of Minorad and the Sand Seas , but south of the Northern Ice Wastes . They are inhabited by ogres , trolls , and the hardiest of Golth barbarians .
